question: Industry anonymity benchmark: find the primary source of the claims that fewer than 4% of DAF grants by count but about 9% of DAF grant dollars are fully anonymous ('National Study on DAFs', relayed in webinar summaries), and record definition, sample and year, so sponsor-level 4-5% count shares can be set against a dollar share

rationale: Every sponsor figure found (Fidelity 4-5%, Vanguard 4%/5%, NPT snippet ~4%) is a count share; a dollar share would show whether large grants are disproportionately anonymous, which matters for nonprofit-side revenue attribution
